decisions.reason: The encrypted second channel is the backbone of the firm's secure-ecosystem strategy and costs little to keep, so its absence from the website more likely reflects rebranding or integration into the platform than a failed option.
Mobile PDF signing is a cheap feature close to the core and supports the move into online contract signing, so keeping the option open remains sensible even though it has had little visibility.
After four years without visible traction, the uncertainty about this niche email-to-app robot has largely resolved against it, and its resources are better used in the core platform.

Now that the PSD2 strong-authentication wave has passed, app-based authenticators have won out over hardware tokens, so this costly hardware option has shown that its value is unlikely to be realized.
Payment compliance requirements keep changing and this suite builds on existing know-how, so its value is still plausible at moderate cost, although its lack of visibility calls for close monitoring.
